title: Wire clampDodgeParams into the dodge-timeline editor updateParam
body:
## Summary
The dodge timeline editor writes each slider value raw; the cross-field clamp built for it (clampDodgeParams) has 0 callers, so i-frames can run past the dodge.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/dodge-timeline/index.tsx:71 updateParam does setParams(prev => ({...prev, [key]: value})) with no cross-field check. Slider bounds in src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/dodge-types.ts:68 allow dodgeDuration 0.1 with iFrameStart 0.5 + iFrameDuration 1.0, i.e. 1.5 s of invulnerability on a 0.1 s dodge, which FrameDataTable and the export then carry. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/dodge-math.ts:16 clampDodgeParams enforces exactly these invariants (now safeDur-guarded, commit 96dd6c46) but git grep finds no caller since the 5f863864 restructure. Fixed = updateParam (and the initialParams seed at index.tsx:28) pass through clampDodgeParams.

## Flow
- open Dodge Timeline, set Duration 0.1, I-Frame Dur. 1.0
- index.tsx:71 stores raw values
- TimelineBar/FrameDataTable render i-frames ending at 1.5 s, past a 0.1 s movement phase
- fix: setParams(prev => clampDodgeParams({...prev, [key]: value}))

## Expected impact
Designers can no longer author or export an impossible dodge (i-frames outliving the move). Could break: a test that pins the unclamped intermediate value.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every edit keeps the dodge invariants
Before: 0 callers of clampDodgeParams; the raw state for dur 0.1 / iFrameDur 1.0 violates i-frames <= duration
After: predicted 0 invariant violations after any slider sequence
Method: simulation - the fix site is a sibling-owned file (combat-dodge-timeline) dirty this wave; this round could not build it
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/dodge-timeline/index.tsx:71-73 updateParam raw set
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/dodge-math.ts:16 clampDodgeParams - git grep -lw clampDodgeParams -> 1 file (its definition)
instrument: component test: render DodgeTimelineEditor, fireEvent.change Duration=0.1 and I-Frame Dur.=1.0, assert the i-frame phase end <= dodgeDuration in the rendered FrameDataTable

title: Combat KPI cards present hard-coded figures as measured telemetry
body:
## Summary
The Metrics tab KPI cards, hit stats and trace tile show fixed numbers worded as live measurements with no data source behind them.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data-metrics.ts:315 KPI_CARDS hard-codes "Total Damage Dealt 12,450 +15%", "Crit Rate 18%", "Dodge Success 85%", each with a context claiming a window ("Last 100 combat encounters", "Rolling avg over 500 attacks") - the context field is never rendered (0 readers) and no encounter log exists. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data.ts:134 HIT_STATS ("Hit Rate 67%") and src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/metrics/TracesMetric.tsx:7 (sphere vs capsule inferred from a radius threshold over 5 sample frames) are the same class. The registry technique real-vs-illustrative-form-encoding and data-viz "a number that travels carries its predicate" both require a sample figure to be visibly marked as sample, or replaced by a computed one. Choosing which (wire to UE/sim telemetry, derive from the canon roster, or label illustrative) is a product call.

## Flow
- open Combat > Combat Metrics
- KPI grid renders 4 fixed values from KPI_CARDS
- nothing distinguishes them from the computed DPS rows beside them

## Expected impact
Designers stop balancing against invented numbers. Could break: nothing functional; the choice changes what the tab promises.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every figure on the tab is either computed or marked sample
Before: 4 KPI cards + 3 HIT_STATS + 1 trace tile = 8 uncomputed figures, 0 marked sample
After: unmeasurable until the direction is chosen (wire vs label vs remove)
Method: probe - counted the figures and their sources; the after figure depends on a product choice
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction - wire real telemetry, derive from the roster, or label as illustrative
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data-metrics.ts:315-320 KPI_CARDS literals
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/metrics/MetricsTab.tsx:67 renders kpi.value; grep "kpi.context" -> 0 hits
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data.ts:134 HIT_STATS literals

title: Effectiveness heatmap is a second damage-type model off the canon kernel
body:
## Summary
The damage-type x armour-class heatmap uses its own types and multipliers that the canon kernel does not have.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data-metrics.ts:193 DMG_TYPES = Physical/Fire/Ice/Lightning against ARMOR_TYPES Light/Medium/Heavy/Magical with multipliers up to 1.5x. The canon kernel (src/lib/combat/canon-kernel.ts:29) has Physical/Fire/Cold/Lightning/Chaos, mitigates Physical by an armour rating and elementals by a per-type resist capped at 75% - no armour classes, and "Ice" is not a canon type (also a weapon element at data-metrics.ts:54 Frostbite Cleaver). WeaponMatchupPanel already says "no resist model yet". So two damage models are shown in one module (realtime-combat-semantics / design-canon-as-executable-law: one law). This round made the heatmap internally consistent (commit 61e8a624) but did not change its model. Fixed = the heatmap reads computeHit over canon types against named defence profiles, or is retired.

## Flow
- Combat > Analysis & Hits renders the heatmap (hits/HitsTab.tsx:112)
- Fire vs Light reads 1.5x
- canon computeHit on the same pair cannot produce a 1.5x amplification from an armour class

## Expected impact
One damage law across the combat tabs. Could break: HitsTab visuals and any designer relying on the 4x4 table.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one damage-type model across combat surfaces
Before: 2 models: 4 heatmap types (1 non-canon: Ice) x 4 armour classes vs 5 canon types x rating/resist
After: predicted 1 model
Method: simulation - walked Fire vs Light, Ice vs Medium, Physical vs Heavy under both; L-sized and changes what the heatmap means
Result: better
Gate: architecture - retire or re-derive the heatmap on canon
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data-metrics.ts:193-194 DMG_TYPES/ARMOR_TYPES
src/lib/combat/canon-kernel.ts:29 DamageType = Physical|Fire|Cold|Lightning|Chaos
src/lib/combat/canon-kernel.ts:182 resist capped, armour by rating

title: Related Combos show authored DPS 6-13x the weapon law beside it
body:
## Summary
In the weapon comparison, combo DPS (authored) sits on the same panel as weapon DPS (canon law) and is an order of magnitude larger for every combo.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data-metrics.ts:127 COMBO_SEQUENCES carries a typed dps (190-350). src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/metrics/WeaponMatchupPanel.tsx renders them under the compare rows whose DPS comes from weapon-throughput (roster max 38.1). Probe: 31 of 31 combos exceed 2x the best weapon of their category; ratios 8.0x (Slash Combo) to 13.0x (Lance Charge: 1 hit, 1.5 s, 310 DPS = 465 damage per hit from a 20-28 lance). The label says "authored DPS", but metric-identity (data-viz) forbids one named number with two derivations on one surface. Fixed = combo DPS derived (hits x category expected hit / totalTime via weapon-throughput) or renamed to a unitless score.

## Flow
- Metrics tab > select Mounted Lance and Halberd
- compare rows read ~20 DPS
- Related Combos read 210-310 DPS for the same weapons

## Expected impact
Designers read one DPS scale. Could break: combo bars rescale; combo-chain tests that pin dps.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one DPS meaning per surface
Before: 31/31 combos >2x their category best weapon (probe over WEAPON_ROSTER, 2026-11-08)
After: predicted 0/31 once derived
Method: probe - computed ratios over the real tables; the derivation formula is a design choice not built this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
probe output: cb-sw-basic 245 vs cat-max 30.6 x8.0 ... cb-pl-charge 310 vs cat-max 23.9 x13.0; over2x=31/31 rosterMax=38.1
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/data-metrics.ts:169 cb-pl-charge hits 1 totalTime 1.5s dps 310
instrument: test: for each COMBO_SEQUENCES entry, derived dps / category max roster dps <= 2; plus a render check that the Related Combos value equals the derivation

title: KPIs feature-map tile shows three constant lights that encode nothing
body:
## Summary
The "kpis" Feature Map tile renders three fixed-colour dots labelled TTK/DPS/APM regardless of any data.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/metrics/KpisMetric.tsx:5 LIGHTS is a constant array; each dot is aria-hidden with a title, so it is neither data nor accessible. Every sibling tile (dps, stats, effectiveness) reads WEAPON_ROSTER. A status light that is always green is the health-rollup anti-pattern (a light that cannot go red). Fixed = the tile prints one computed figure (e.g. best weapon TTK vs the default matchup target from weapon-matchup) or is removed from METRIC_MAP.

## Flow
- Feature Map renders renderCombatMetric("kpis")
- three dots, same colours always
- no figure, nothing for a screen reader

## Expected impact
The tile carries information or disappears. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the tile reflects data
Before: 0 data inputs, 3 aria-hidden constant marks
After: predicted 1 computed figure
Method: probe - read the component; which figure to show is a small product choice
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: render renderCombatMetric("kpis") and assert its text equals a figure computed from rankForTarget(WEAPONS, <default target>)

title: DPS bar chart values are mouse-hover only; metric SVGs have no name
body:
## Summary
GroupedDpsBarChart exposes each weapon value only through onMouseEnter; the three metric SVG charts carry no role or accessible name.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/metrics/GroupedDpsBarChart.tsx:52 sets the tooltip on mouse enter only - 44 bars, 0 focusable, 0 with a title/aria-label, so keyboard and screen-reader users get no per-weapon value. The svg roots at GroupedDpsBarChart.tsx:26, ProportionalSankey.tsx:66 and CumulativeDamageSvg.tsx:16 have no role="img"/aria-label/<title> (data-viz accessibility posture: a chart has a text alternative). Fixed = each bar gets a <title> (or focusable + onFocus) and each svg role="img" with a summary label.

## Flow
- tab through the Metrics tab
- focus never lands on a bar
- a screen reader announces an unnamed graphic three times

## Expected impact
Per-weapon DPS reachable without a mouse. Could break: e2e selectors on rects.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - chart values reachable without hover
Before: 44/44 bars hover-only; 3/3 svgs unnamed
After: predicted 0/44 and 0/3
Method: probe - counted from source; M across 3 files, left for an isolated run
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/metrics/GroupedDpsBarChart.tsx:50-54 rect with onMouseEnter only
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/metrics/ProportionalSankey.tsx:66 <svg> without role/label
instrument: render MetricsTab, assert every rect in the grouped chart has a <title> or aria-label containing the weapon name, and each metrics svg has role=img with a non-empty aria-label

title: Drop three zero-consumer dodge-types exports (one duplicated inline)
body:
## Summary
dodge-types exports ExportFormat, DodgeTimelineEditorProps and REFERENCE_MONTAGE_LENGTH with no consumers; the props type is re-declared inline by the editor.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/dodge-types.ts:47 ExportFormat, :51 DodgeTimelineEditorProps, :93 REFERENCE_MONTAGE_LENGTH - git grep -lw finds only the definition for each. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/dodge-timeline/index.tsx:27 types its props inline as { initialParams?: Partial<DodgeParams> }, the same shape as DodgeTimelineEditorProps (a pair). Not built this round: the dodge-timeline sibling had index.tsx dirty (veto 4). Fixed = the editor uses DodgeTimelineEditorProps and the other two are deleted, or all three are deleted.

## Flow
- git grep -lw ExportFormat / DodgeTimelineEditorProps / REFERENCE_MONTAGE_LENGTH
- each returns only dodge-types.ts

## Expected impact
Smaller shared surface for the dodge contexts. Could break: nothing (0 consumers).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no orphaned exports in _shared
Before: 3 zero-consumer exports
After: 0
Method: probe - zero-consumer grep; held on veto 4 (sibling-dirty consumer file)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
git grep -lw ExportFormat -> src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/dodge-types.ts only
git grep -lw DodgeTimelineEditorProps -> same
git grep -lw REFERENCE_MONTAGE_LENGTH -> same
instrument: export-surface guard like combat-metrics-data.test.ts "carries no orphaned sample exports", over dodge-types
